title: ‘Dangerously hostile’: heatwaves leave hospital wards unsafe, data reveals

paragraphs.en: Hospitals in England have recorded temperatures of almost 42C this summer, with surgeries being cancelled because operating theatres’ cooling units stopped working in the intense heat.
paragraphs.zh: 今年夏天，英格兰医院的最高气温接近42摄氏度，由于手术室制冷机组在酷热中停止工作，一些手术被迫取消。

paragraphs.en: The Northern Care Alliance NHS foundation trust, which runs four hospitals in Greater Manchester, recorded a temperature of 41.8C during last month’s heatwave – 14C above the recommended safe maximum.
paragraphs.zh: 运营大曼彻斯特地区四家医院的北方护理联盟NHS基金会信托上月热浪期间记录到41.8摄氏度的高温，比建议的安全上限高出14摄氏度。

paragraphs.en: Figures disclosed by 33 NHS trusts under freedom of information laws show that temperatures on wards during July averaged 31.9C – above the 28C which NHS England advises is the limit hospitals should maintain in order to protect the safety of staff and patients .
paragraphs.zh: 根据33家NHS信托根据信息自由法披露的数据，7月份病房的平均气温为31.9摄氏度，高于英格兰NHS建议医院为保护医护人员和患者安全应维持的28摄氏度上限。

paragraphs.en: The Liberal Democrats, who obtained the data, said hospitals are being affected so badly by record-breaking temperatures that ministers must set up a new “NHS rapid adaptation unit” to heatproof hospitals and care homes by installing ways to keep them cool, such as air conditioning.
paragraphs.zh: 获得这些数据的自由民主党表示，创纪录的高温对医院的影响十分严重，部长们必须成立一个新的“NHS快速适应部门”，通过安装空调等降温设施，让医院和养老院具备防暑能力。

paragraphs.en: It would “heatproof vulnerable facilities, make air conditioning mandatory in all care homes and urgently upgrade NHS buildings to withstand future heatwaves. We need to make our hospitals fit for the future,”said Helen Morgan, the party’s health spokesperson.
paragraphs.zh: “这将为脆弱的设施做好防暑准备，强制所有养老院安装空调，并紧急升级NHS建筑以抵御未来的热浪。我们必须让我们的医院适应未来，”该党健康事务发言人海伦·摩根（Helen Morgan）说。

paragraphs.en: Hospitals are getting so hot that they become “dangerously hostile environments for patients and healthcare workers”, she added.
paragraphs.zh: 她还补充道，医院热到成了“对患者和医护人员来说危险且恶劣的环境”。

paragraphs.en: This summer’s relentless heat has meant that some have been forced to cancel surgeries because operating theatres have become dangerously hot. In some hospitals this is because cooling units which regulate the temperature in operating theatres, which are often sited on the roof of hospital buildings, have failed as a result of exposure to the heat.
paragraphs.zh: 今年夏天持续不断的高温迫使一些医院取消了手术，因为手术室已热到危险的程度。在一些医院，这是因为调节手术室温度的制冷机组（通常安装在医院建筑的屋顶上）因受热而出现故障。

paragraphs.en: Affected trusts have been forced to reschedule planned surgeries. The NHS Alliance, which revealed the intense heat’s latest impact on the NHS, could not say how many of England’s 205 NHS trusts have had to scrap operating lists for that reason.
paragraphs.zh: 受影响的信托被迫重新安排预定的手术。揭露酷热对NHS最新影响的NHS联盟无法说明，英格兰205家NHS信托中有多少家因此取消了手术日程。
